content_sections.heading: Zakir Husain Delhi College Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Zakir Husain Delhi College Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Zakir Husain Delhi College recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Assistant Professor. There are 2 vacancies available for this position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly without any prior online application process.

faq.question: Q3. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 18th August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue well before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility criteria for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must meet the UGC Regulations 2018 for Assistant Professors of Colleges and be enrolled in the latest Adhoc Panel of the respective department of the University of Delhi.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Professor post is 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Zakir Husain Delhi College located?
faq.answer: Zakir Husain Delhi College is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110002.
